content:
Repo here: https://github.com/poscat0x04/isabelle-prime-repro
Run isabelle build -D . at project root to reproduce error.
Root cause seems to be that \isasymZprime is undefined in isabellesym.sty

Found a workaround: add

\newcommand{\isasymZprime}{\isamath{^\prime}}

to your root.tex
Seems like something that should be sent to the Isabelle developers. Include the Isabelle version you used in your email.
